_comment: Safety-layer profiles (src/vla_robot_sorting/safety/action_filter.py, ADR 0004). Base frame of the Panthera-HT: z up, z = 0 at the mounting surface. Joint limits from panthera_6dof.urdf. The simulation profile admits the scripted expert's motion (velocity <= 1.41 rad/s, acceleration p99 <= 2.3 rad/s^2, tool point inside the box, measured on panthera_twin_v1); the real profile starts slower and is revisited after the first low-speed tests.
